Snippet:  Model Preparation \

 Resume from a Checkpoint \

Set `actor.model.model_path` to a downloaded checkpoint directory; architecture and weights load from that path. Options:

-  DreamZero 14B (DROID / AgiBot): DreamZero-DROID, DreamZero-AgiBot — see `droid_sft_dreamzero_14b.yaml`

-  RLinf 5B (LIBERO SFT): RLinf-DreamZero-WAN2.2-5B-LIBERO-SFT-Step18000 — see `libero_sft_dreamzero_5b.yaml` and point `model_path` at that directory

Download example:

```
pip install -U huggingface_hub
huggingface-cli download GEAR-Dreams/DreamZero-DROID --local-dir ./DreamZero-DROID

```

YAML example (DROID + official 14B; see `droid_sft_dreamzero_14b.yaml`):

```
defaults:
  - model/dreamzero_14b@actor.model

actor:
  model:
    model_path: ./DreamZero-DROID
    tokenizer_path: google/umt5-xxl
    embodiment_tag: oxe_droid

`

Title: dreamzero/docs/WAN22_BACKBONE.md at main · dreamzero0/dreamzero
Site: Github
Date: 2026-01-27
URL: https://github.com/dreamzero0/dreamzero/blob/main/docs/WAN22_BACKBONE.md
Snippet:  File Layout

Permalink: File Layout

```
dreamzero/
├── groot/vla/configs/model/dreamzero/action_head/
│   ├── wan_flow_matching_action_tf.yaml       Wan2.1 (default)
│   └── wan_flow_matching_action_tf_wan22.yaml   Wan2.2-TI2V-5B
├── scripts/train/
│   ├── droid_training.sh            Wan2.1 backbone
│   └── droid_training_wan22.sh      Wan2.2 backbone
└── docs/
    └── WAN22_BACKBONE.md           This file

```

The action head ( `wan_flow_matching_action_tf.py`) automatically detects Wan2.2 vs Wan2.1 based on `in_dim` (48 vs 16) and `vae.z_dim` (48 vs 16), and loads the correct checkpoint files from the appropriate HuggingFace repos when local paths are not found.

 Download the pretrained checkpoint

Permalink: Download the pretrained checkpoint

The training scripts load from a pretrained DreamZero checkpoint for LoRA fine-tuning. Download DreamZero-AgiBot (~45GB) to `./checkpoints/DreamZero-AgiBot`:

```
git clone https://huggingface.co/GEAR-Dreams/DreamZero-AgiBot ./checkpoints/DreamZero-AgiBot
```

Or with the Hugging Face CLI:

```
hf download GEAR-Dreams/DreamZero-AgiBot --repo-type model --local-dir ./checkpoints/DreamZero-AgiBot
```

 Launch training

Permalink: Launch training

DATA_ROOT=/path/to/your_dataset bash scripts/train/<EMBODIMENT>_training.sh

 With overrides:
DATA_ROOT=/path/to/your_dataset OUTPUT_DIR=./checkpoints/run1 NUM_GPUS=4 \

> Training on a new embodiment? See Adding a New Embodiment to DreamZero for a complete guide on converting your dataset, configuring modalities, and launching training. _Make sure to align the 3 camera view order to ensure positive transfer._

 Downloading Pretrained Base Model Weights

Permalink: Downloading Pretrained Base Model Weights

DreamZero is built on top of Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P and uses the umt5-xxl tokenizer. Download both before training:

```
pip install "huggingface_hub[cli]"

 You may need to set your HuggingFace token:
 export HF_TOKEN=<YOUR_HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN>

 Download Wan2.1 model weights (~28GB)
hf download Wan-AI/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P --local-dir ./checkpoints/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P

 Download umt5-xxl tokenizer
hf download google/umt5-xxl --local-dir .

|---|---|

| tokenizer | google/umt5-xxl |
| 训练栈 | 代码基于 Isaac-GR00T 仓库结构改的（`groot/vla/...`），支持 LoRA 微调、新本体接入指南 |

所以"Wan2.x + OXE 训过"的现成答案就是 **DreamZero-DROID**；和你们 E-003 同 5B backbone 的则是它的 Wan2.2 变体/RLinf 的 LIBERO ckpt。

**其他沾边的**：

- **ABot-M0.5**：正是 Wan2.2 + 大数据混合训练，但**闭源**，只能读论文；
- **LingBot-VA 2.0**（蚂蚁灵波）：16k 小时含 OXE，但 backbone 是自研 MoE 视频流，不是 Wan；
- **WorldDreamer**：27 OXE 本体训过但 backbone 是 Qwen3-VL，不是 Wan——它是唯一"OXE 训过 + Qwen 系"的。

**对 E-003（WanPI 线）的含义**：

1. **初始化候选**：如果接受 14B 体量，`DreamZero-DROID` 是直接带 OXE 动作先验的 Wan 系初始化；如果坚持 TI2V-5B（我们现在的 backbone、4090 友好），它没有现成的 OXE ckpt（只有 Wan2.1-14B 的 DROID/AgiBot 和 Wan2.2-5B 的 LIBERO）——**想用 5B 就得用它的代码在 OXE 上自己训**，或者用 14B DROID ckpt 蒸馏/迁移。
2. **方法论差异要注意**：DreamZero 在推理时**真的生成未来视频**（自回归、成本高），和我们"future latent 只当训练监督、推理只出动作"的路线不同——它和 GigaWorld-Policy 的区别正好对应两条 WAM 子路线。对我们更重要的参考是它的**联合训练目标怎么构造**（视频+动作 latent 联合去噪、clean context 条件）和 embodiment_tag 机制，而不是它的推理形态。
3. 一个现实提醒：它的训练栈是 GR00T 系（不是 StarVLA），引入做初始化=又要过一次"外国栈"适配，成本和接 GR00T 相当——但如果你认真考虑"Wan 系 + OXE 初始化"，这是目前**唯一开源且对得上 backbone 家族的选项**。

{
  "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# MoWA 初始化候选模型批量下载（夜间任务）\n# 每个仓库最多重试 3 次；hf download 自带断点续传。\nset -u\nDEST_ROOT=/disk/rl/models/mowa_init_candidates\nLOG=/disk/rl/models/mowa_init_candidates/download.log\nHF=/disk/rl/starVLA/.robocase/bin/hf\nmkdir -p \"$DEST_ROOT\"\n\ndownload() {\n  local repo=$1 dest=$2 exclude=${3:-}\n  echo \"===== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $repo -> $dest =====\" | tee -a \"$LOG\"\n  for attempt in 1 2 3; do\n    if [[ -n \"$exclude\" ]]; then\n      \"$HF\" download \"$repo\" --exclude \"$exclude\" --local-dir \"$dest\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>&1\n    else\n      \"$HF\" download \"$repo\" --local-dir \"$dest\" >> \"$LOG\" 2>&1\n    fi\n    rc=$?\n    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then\n      echo \"[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] OK  $repo\" | tee -a \"$LOG\"; return 0\n    fi\n    echo \"[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] FAIL($rc) $repo attempt $attempt，10s 后重试\" | tee -a \"$LOG\"\n    sleep 10\n  done\n  echo \"[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] GIVEUP $repo\" | tee -a \"$LOG\"; return 1\n}\n\ndownload \"StarVLA/Qwen3-VL-GR00T-Robocasa-gr1\"        \"$DEST_ROOT/Qwen3-VL-GR00T-Robocasa-gr1\"\ndownload \"StarVLA/Qwen3VL-GR00T-Bridge-RT-1\"          \"$DEST_ROOT/Qwen3VL-GR00T-Bridge-RT-1\"\ndownload \"StarVLA/Qwen3VL-PI_v3-Bridge-RT_1\"          \"$DEST_ROOT/Qwen3VL-PI_v3-Bridge-RT_1\"\ndownload \"StarVLA/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-Action\"        \"$DEST_ROOT/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-Action\"\ndownload \"StarVLA/WM4A-Wan2d2-OFT-LIBERO-4in1\"        \"$DEST_ROOT/WM4A-Wan2d2-OFT-LIBERO-4in1\"\ndownload \"WorldAgents-c/world_dreamer-robocasa365-multi_task\" \"$DEST_ROOT/world_dreamer-robocasa365-multi_task\"\ndownload \"GEAR-Dreams/DreamZero-DROID\"                \"$DEST_ROOT/DreamZero-DROID\" \"tensorrt/*\"\n\necho \"===== [$(date +%H:%M:%S)] ALL DONE =====\" | tee -a \"$LOG\"\n",
